description: GLM-5.3-Flash NVFP4 (Local Inference Lab R35) on 4x RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell: vLLM TP4, B12X attention/MoE/linear, native MTP3 (probabilistic draft), FP8 KV pinned at 31 GiB/GPU (4,576,303-token pool), 400K context, 48 sequences, 8192 batched tokens, CUDA graphs 1-192, vision (64 images). The owner's production config after the blackwell-forge campaign (2026-09-25/26, K8).

acceptance.harness: blackwell-forge bench.py smoke (17 x 23 = 391, tool call) and coherence cells
acceptance.note: K8: smoke passed (391, tool call), vision 8/8 at 1024x768, coherence at 276,064 tokens; K5 (same config, full graph list) smoke passed.

metadata.benchmark_workload: Warm structured-number continuation, temperature 1, top_p 0.95, reasoning disabled only for benchmarking; exact token IDs counted in common 30s/60s windows. No isolated pure prefill result.

metadata.deployment_notes: Download target and draft with the pinned package script before raw engine launch. Bind raw engine only on a trusted private network; prefer authenticated Compose package. No GPU power changes.
metadata.history_policy: Standalone Compose proxy or Local Studio controller prunes older images to 8 while protecting the latest user message and subsequent tool results. Raw engine Docker launch alone does not provide this proxy policy or API authentication.
metadata.limits: 400k is a configured per-request ceiling, not 400k measured at all concurrencies. Accepted C8 held 379,951 input tokens each; profile allocated 4,055,230 total KV tokens. No 24/7/365 guarantee; 64px mixed-history vision counterexample published.
metadata.validation_scope: Existing Local Studio engine validated; standalone Docker gateway validated against it. Complete Compose orchestration configuration-checked, not cold-started over the occupied production GPUs.

sources.note: pop-os controller recipe (the one serving production), read-only
